panels.title: Paying Subscribers
panels.description: Total unique users who completed a purchase

url_options.data: {"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT count(DISTINCT person_id) as paying_subscribers FROM events WHERE event = 'purchase_completed' AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00'))"}}

{"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT step, users FROM (SELECT 1 as ord, 'Installed' as step, count(DISTINCT person_id) as users FROM events WHERE event = 'app_initialized' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Scan Completed', count(DISTINCT person_id) FROM events WHERE event = 'onboarding_scan_completed' AND timestamp >= now() - {"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT person_id) FROM events WHERE event = 'onboarding_completed' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00'))) * 1.0 / (SELECT count(DISTINCT person_id) FROM events WHERE event = 'app_initialized' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00'))) as rate"}}

panels.title: % Paywall Seen Day 1
panels.description: Users who saw the paywall on their first day

url_options.data: {"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "WITH new_users AS (SELECT person_id, min(timestamp) as first_seen FROM events WHERE event = 'app_initialized' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) GROUP BY person_id), paywall_day1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT e.person_id FROM events e JOIN new_users n ON e.person_id = n.person_id WHERE e.event = 'paywall_shown' AND e.timestamp <= n.first_seen + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00'))) SELECT count() / (SELECT count() FROM new_users) as rate FROM paywall_day1"}}

{"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT step, users FROM (SELECT 1 as ord, 'Paywall Shown' as step, count(DISTINCT person_id) as users FROM events WHERE event = 'paywall_shown' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Plan Selected', count(DISTINCT person_id) FROM events WHERE event = 'paywall_plan_selected' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Purchase Started', count(DISTINCT person_id) FROM events WHERE event = 'purchase_started' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Purchase Completed', count(DISTINCT person_id) FROM events WHERE event = 'purchase_completed' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00'))) ORDER BY ord"}}

{"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT toDate(timestamp) as day, count(DISTINCT person_id) as trials FROM events WHERE event = 'purchase_started' AND timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})  AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day"}}

{"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT count(DISTINCT if(event = 'purchase_completed', person_id, NULL)) * 1.0 / count(DISTINCT if(event = 'purchase_started', person_id, NULL)) as rate FROM events WHERE event IN ('purchase_started', 'purchase_completed') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00'))"}}

{"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT properties.plan_id as plan, count(DISTINCT person_id) as users FROM events WHERE event = 'purchase_completed' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY  AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) GROUP BY plan ORDER BY users DESC"}}

INTERVAL 30 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Album Cleaning', count(DISTINCT person_id) FROM events WHERE event = 'album_tutorial_completed' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00'))) ORDER BY ord"}}

{"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT round(avg(properties.reviewed_count), 1) as avg_reviewed FROM events WHERE event = 'swipe_session_summary' AND toFloat(properties.total_media_count) >= 100 AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00'))"}}

{"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT sum(properties.deleted_count) as total_deleted FROM events WHERE event = 'photos_deleted' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00'))"}}

{"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT round(sum(properties.freed_bytes) / 1073741824, 2) as gb_freed FROM events WHERE event = 'photos_deleted' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00'))"}}

{"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "WITH dau AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT person_id) as cnt FROM events WHERE event = 'Application Opened' AND toDate(timestamp) = today() AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00'))), mau AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT person_id) as cnt FROM events WHERE event = 'Application Opened' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00'))) SELECT dau.cnt / mau.cnt as stickiness FROM dau, mau"}}

{"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT properties.$app_version as version, count(DISTINCT person_id) as users FROM events WHERE event = 'Application Opened' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND properties.$app_version IS NOT NULL  AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) GROUP BY version ORDER BY users DESC LIMIT 10"}}

Installed' as step, count(DISTINCT person_id) as users FROM events WHERE event = 'app_initialized' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) UNION ALL SELECT 2, '2. First Deletion', count(DISTINCT person_id) FROM events WHERE event = 'first_deletion' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) UNION ALL SELECT 6, '6. {"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "WITH cohorts AS (SELECT person_id, toStartOfWeek(min(timestamp)) as cohort_week FROM events WHERE event = 'app_initialized' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) GROUP BY person_id), activity AS (SELECT e.person_id, c.cohort_week, floor(dateDiff('day', c.cohort_week, toDate(e.timestamp)) / 7) as week_number FROM events e JOIN cohorts c ON e.person_id = c.person_id WHERE e.event = 'Application Opened' AND e.timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY) SELECT toString(cohort_week) as Cohort, count(DISTINCT if(week_number = 0, person_id, NULL)) as W0, count(DISTINCT if(week_number = 1, person_id, NULL)) as W1, count(DISTINCT if(week_number = 2, person_id, NULL)) as W2, count(DISTINCT if(week_number = 3, person_id, NULL)) as W3, count(DISTINCT if(week_number = 4, person_id, NULL)) as W4 FROM activity GROUP BY cohort_week ORDER BY cohort_week"}}

{"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT properties.paywall_type as paywall, count(DISTINCT person_id) as users FROM events WHERE event = 'paywall_shown' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) GROUP BY paywall HAVING paywall NOT IN ('feature', 'soft') ORDER BY users DESC"}}

panels.title: Paywall Conversion by Type
panels.description: Shown → Purchased conversion rate per paywall type

url_options.data: {"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT shown.paywall as paywall, if(shown.users > 0, purchased.users * 1.0 / shown.users, 0) as conversion_rate FROM (SELECT properties.paywall_type as paywall, count(DISTINCT person_id) as users FROM events WHERE event = 'paywall_shown' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) GROUP BY paywall HAVING paywall NOT IN ('feature', 'soft')) as shown LEFT JOIN (SELECT properties.paywall_type as paywall, count(DISTINCT person_id) as users FROM events WHERE event = 'purchase_completed' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) GROUP BY paywall) as purchased ON shown.paywall = purchased.paywall ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC"}}

panels.title: Install → Trial Split

panels.title: Trial Start Rate
panels.description: % of installs that started a trial

url_options.data: {"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT person_id) FROM events WHERE event = 'purchase_started' AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00'))) * 1.0 / (SELECT count(DISTINCT person_id) FROM events WHERE event = 'app_initialized' AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00'))) as rate"}}

{"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT toDate(timestamp) as day, count(DISTINCT person_id) as installs FROM events WHERE event = 'app_initialized' AND timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})  AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day"}}

{"query": {"kind": "HogQLQuery", "query": "SELECT toDate(timestamp) as day, count(DISTINCT person_id) as trials FROM events WHERE event = 'purchase_started' AND timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})  AND ('${install_source}' = 'all' OR properties.install_source = '${install_source}' OR ('${install_source}' = 'testflight' AND properties.install_source = 'app_store')) AND ('${install_source}' != 'app_store' OR timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-03-18 20:00:00')) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day"}}
